cycleRead.summary: The new production posture is live. Traffic is still holding at the prior floor, so the system should keep watching for the first measurable hit against the full compatibility loop instead of splitting into side niches.

compatibilityLoop.rankTarget: Users looking for an alternative to passive YouTube-style entertainment that still feels compatible with the behaviors they already know.
loop: Auto Play continues the episode flow
Next Episode and Previous Episode keep the session compatible
3D Model View gives the topic a visual object
Podcast Play interrupts as a source/speaker moment
analytics explains the media in the same view
watch/blog/source proof routes give Google and users a crawlable trail
compatibilityLoop.seoRule: Every keyword cluster should point to this loop first, then branch into gamer, real estate, planetary, exotic environment, structure, mainstream, researcher, programmer, workforce, and market categories.

nextSeoTickers.action: Keep reinforcing full interface language in public proof maps: autoplay, next/previous, video search, sound, 3D Model View, podcast play, analytics.
Route every category into the full loop instead of treating categories as standalone products.
Watch whether users open watch/blog/source routes after seeing the full system positioning.
Do not claim rank movement until Google returns rows, impressions, clicks, position, or fresh indexed routes.

doNotDo: do not change UI during standby
do not deploy if traffic is flat and no proof artifact changes
do not claim ranking movement without Search Console rows
standbyInstruction.ifHit: Notify with exact pool, numbers, category, SEO decision, and whether to absorb into the master list.
standbyInstruction.ifFlat: Report flat numbers briefly and keep the next move focused on the full compatibility loop.
